#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;
const ll INF = 1000000000000000001LL;

ll nCr[100][100];

ll f(ll p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p *= nCr[a][b];
    p %= MOD;
    p *= nCr[c][d];
    p %= MOD;
    return p;
}

int pack(int x, int y, int z) {
    return (x * 200 + y) * 2 + z;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50)
            cnt1++;
        else
            cnt2++;
    }

    vector<vector<vector<ll>>> dist(200, vector<vector<ll>>(200, vector<ll>(2, INF)));
    vector<vector<vector<ll>>> dp(200, vector<vector<ll>>(200, vector<ll>(2, 0)));

    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;

    vector<int> frontier, next;
    frontier.push_back(pack(0, 0, 0));

    while (!frontier.empty()) {
        next.clear();
        for (int id : frontier) {
            int z = id & 1;
            int t = id >> 1;
            int y = t % 200;
            int x = t / 200;
            ll d = dist[x][y][z];

            if (z == 0) {
                int remX = cnt1 - x;
                int remY = cnt2 - y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                        if (i + j == 0)
                            continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K)
                            break;
                        ll ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                        int nx = x + i;
                        int ny = y + j;
                        int nz = z ^ 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                            next.push_back(pack(nx, ny, nz));
                        } else if (dist[nx][ny][nz] == d + 1) {
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int remX = x;
                int remY = y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                        if (i + j == 0)
                            continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K)
                            break;
                        ll ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                        int nx = x - i;
                        int ny = y - j;
                        int nz = z ^ 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                            next.push_back(pack(nx, ny, nz));
                        } else if (dist[nx][ny][nz] == d + 1) {
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        swap(frontier, next);
    }

    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF)
        cout << -1 << "\n";
    else
        cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << "\n";
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
